address: Four Seasons Resort, 502 Mu 1, Mae Rim-Samoeng Old Road, Rim Tai, Mae Rim, Chiang Mai, 50180, Thailand
bio: Khao serves Northern Thai cuisine, along with some dishes from other regions. The chef, a prestigious culinary school graduate with 10 years of luxury hotel experience, brings an international perspective and a modern identity to traditional Thai dishes. The dining room is contemporary and inviting – crystal chandeliers coexist with carved teak panelling – and the terrace offers serene views of rice fields and hills....
